services._note: One profile for every runit distribution: assets/runitctl finds at run time the directory the system runsvdir watches (from /proc), the persistent directory behind it and the service sources (/etc/sv, /etc/runit/sv, /usr/share/runit/sv.current), so Void (/etc/sv, /var/service) and Artix (/etc/runit/sv, /run/runit/service) need no profile of their own. start, stop and restart wait up to 15 s for runsv to pick up a newly linked service and for the service to reach the state. enable_offline and disable_offline run in the installer's chroot, before FreedomNAS (and runitctl) is installed there and while no runsvdir runs: they link into /etc/runit/runsvdir/default, which both Void and Artix boot from.
services.enable_offline: for d in /etc/sv /etc/runit/sv; do if [ -d $d/{service_name} ]; then ln -sfn $d/{service_name} /etc/runit/runsvdir/default/{service_name}; exit 0; fi; done; echo "no runit service {service_name}" >&2; exit 1
